status_definitions.native_profile: Actual named native calculation; reference parity not implied.
status_definitions.partial: Some functionality or narrower/different profile; residual variants or validation remain.

global_contracts: Duplicate facade/internal wrappers share one row mapping and work package.
PM4Py and OCPA shared concepts share a package, but each source ID and reference selector remains traceable.
Reference selector values are preserved verbatim; backend variants are not automatically counted as distinct algorithms.
Mathematically distinct variants remain named profiles or separate functions. No silent translation of objective, denominator, temporal boundary, tie order or ending condition.
Case-centric inputs and object-centric inputs have separate public namespaces. Internal kernels may be shared only when their contracts are equal.
No source row is marked replaced merely because a similar PIX function exists. All replacement_verified values are inherited, not upgraded.
Package completion requires every retained source semantic profile to pass independent expected-value and counterexample tests.

source_corrections.fact: Pinned Count2Vec is a unigram count baseline via sklearn_vectorization.apply(binary=False,ngram_range=(1,1)), not a learned dense embedding.
Pinned STOCHASTIC_PLAYOUT selects by stochastic map weights; artificial one-second export timestamps are not sampled service times.
Pinned DFG CLASSIC enumerates probable traces using priority queue; PERFORMANCE samples routes/times. PIX enumerate_dfg and playout_dfg remain separate.
